sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- This shirt paired together with the BEAR Reitar pants is supposed to resemble and is reference to the clothing worn by the BEAR playermodels in Escape from Tarkov's predecessor Contract Wars.
- Easter eggs and References: The gloves are modeled on the first generation Mechanix M-Pact 3 in Black. The watch, which is shared between all BEAR uppers, is modeled on the Traser P66 Automatic Pro on a rubber strap.
